# `fnox list`

- **Usage:** `fnox list [FLAGS]`
- **Aliases:** `ls`, `secrets`

List all secrets

## Flags

- **`-f --full`** — Show full provider keys without truncation
- **`-s --sources`** — Show source file paths where secrets are defined
- **`-V --values`** — Show secret values (if available)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Lists the secrets configured in fnox. It does not enumerate every remote vault item. Values are hidden unless you request --values.

```sh
fnox list
fnox list --sources
fnox list --profile production
```
